_about: Aeschylus in English, translator per title. Complete in two translators: E. H. Plumptre (verse; Tragedies and Fragments) and John Stuart Blackie (verse, 1850; Lyrical Dramas). Also E. D. A. Morshead (verse; House of Atreus 1881 and Four Plays), T. A. Buckley (prose, Bohn), Gilbert Murray (Agamemnon, rhyming verse; Gutenberg clears it as US PD; Murray d. 1957, not PD in life+70 countries). Publication years are given only where checked in the file; Murray's per-play years were not, so they are left out. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.
